classification.description: Classification data. CZ: nace = primary NACE code from ARES (CZ-NACE 2008), naceCodes = full array of registered codes from ARES, region/district = ARES sídlo.kraj/okres, spisovaZnacka from MSP. SK: nace = single 4-digit NACE from finstat, spisovaZnacka from RPO. employeeCategory is populated only for some larger SK firms.

financials.description: Latest-year financial figures. SK firms: revenue/profit/assets/equity from finstat (typically a.s. and s.r.o. with a published statement). CZ firms: only registeredCapital from MSP rejstřík. Subjects with no disclosure obligation (SVJ, spolek, small s.r.o., state organizations) return null.

financialHistory.description: Up to 5 years of financial history. SK ONLY, for subjects with a published statement (typically a.s. and larger s.r.o.). No free CZ equivalent exists. Each metric is an array of { year, value } points in chronological order.

businessActivities.description: Business activities / scope of operation. CZ: trade licence (license) plus list of activities from MSP. SK: activities only, for subjects with active scope of operation in finstat. Foundations, associations, SVJ and state organizations are typically empty.

directors.description: Statutory body. CZ ONLY (from MSP rejstřík); finstat hides this behind a Premium subscription. Roles vary by entity type: Jednatel (s.r.o.), Předseda/Člen představenstva (a.s.), Předseda/Člen výboru (SVJ, spolek, družstvo), Předseda/Člen správní rady (nadace, ústav), Likvidátor, Prokurista. State organizations, ministries and public universities have no statutory body in ARES.

partners.description: Shareholders / members and their stakes. CZ s.r.o. AND OTHER LEGAL FORMS WITH PUBLIC OWNERSHIP STRUCTURE only. Shareholders of large CZ a.s. are not here — they are private records held by the CDCP central depository. SK subjects have no data here (finstat hides ownership behind Premium). Each partner has a shares[] array with stake details.

warnings.description: Risk flags for KYC / due diligence. CZ: hasInsolvency is derived from ARES (stavZdrojeIr). SK: hasInsolvency / hasDebts / hasTemporaryProtection are read from public flags on finstat.sk. The whole field is null only if no source could supply any of the flags.

vatStatus.description: VAT registration status. CZ ONLY (from ARES stavZdrojeDph). active=true means an active VAT payer. The SK equivalent (icDph) is in the top-level identification fields.

registrace.description: Status across the 6 CZ registries from ARES — CZ ONLY. Values: AKTIVNI / NEEXISTUJICI / ZRUSENI. ROS=Registr osob, VR=Veřejný rejstřík, RES=Registr ekonomických subjektů, RZP=Registr živnostenského podnikání, DPH=VAT payers, IR=insolvenční rejstřík (source of the insolvency flag).

nameHistory.description: History of company names. SK ONLY (from RPO data.gov.sk). Each entry is { name, validFrom, validTo }; validTo:null marks the currently valid name. Useful for auditing mergers, renames and brand changes.

registrationOffice.description: Registry court / registration office. SK ONLY (from RPO). The CZ analogue is in classification.spisovaZnacka.

dataFreshness.description: Timestamps for data freshness audit. aresUpdatedAt = datumAktualizace from ARES (only changes when the subject record is updated). rpoUpdatedAt = dbModificationDate from RPO (only changes on subject updates — values for stable companies can be months or years old). scrapedAt = when this Actor run fetched the data.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Default view — identification, address, classification, latest financial year and warning flags.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Latest-year financial figures plus VAT status and freshness — for performance analysis and basic credit screening.

people.title: Directors & shareholders
people.description: Statutory body and ownership structure (CZ only — sourced from MSP rejstřík).

redFlags.title: Red flags
redFlags.description: Risk signals — insolvency, debts, temporary protection, inactive VAT, dissolution date.
